coverage.methodology: The exact edition boundary is the current corrected English digital core plus Lure of the Valley, represented by the official 2024 rulebook and current living guide. The acquired bounded public governing ledger has 274 deduplicated target-applicable rows: 1 rulebook, 96 Lure guide items, 131 target-applicable or mixed glossary leaves, 32 target-applicable or mixed FAQ Q&As, and 14 core/Lure card updates. The 35 historical Lure guide updates and first-print rulebook update are acquired comparison rows but excluded because their corrections are integrated; the printable errata PDF duplicates the 16 card-update identities. Total governing coverage remains unscored because an authoritative complete rules-bearing distinct-card denominator is unavailable.
